source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: אני יושב בבית קפה ליד הבית.
sentences.en: I'm sitting in a café near home.
The waiter brings me coffee and cake.
I open a laptop and work a bit.
Two friends are sitting and talking.
Outside people pass by in the street.

sentences.ar: אני נשאר שעה ואחר כך הולך.
sentences.en: I stay an hour and then go.
